_comment: Per-repo contract definitions for mcp/src (FR-C2 INPUT, not part of the capability). The graph capability ships the mechanism; these definitions are this repo's own inputs, read from .dioscuri/contracts.json at the audited target root. They are NOT hardcoded into the builder.

contracts.description: searchMemory must only reach shapeResults after the empty-candidate-pool guard returns early; an unguarded path would shape an empty/garbage candidate set.
